info.name: AxiorHub Pilote
info.summary: Assistant for law firms: case sheets, hearings, legal research and validated work, using the AxiorHub engine
info.description:
AxiorHub Pilote brings the AxiorHub engine into Nextcloud: case sheets with sources and coverage, hearing preparation, legal research and work that the lawyer reviews and approves.
**Requires a separately installed AxiorHub engine** (version 5.6.34 or later, contract /integration/v1) reachable from this Nextcloud server. Installing this app installs neither Python, nor Ollama, nor any processing server. A workstation that may be switched off is not a reliable engine for a hosted Nextcloud.
Nextcloud manages the session, users, file permissions and the native interface; the engine manages indexing, models, missions, checks and versioned results. Development version 0.1.0: compatibility is announced only after real installation and tests on each declared server version.
info.author: Timo RAINIO
